subject: RE: FW: VIENNA AIRPORT - SGN / 89 PLT 440 KGS
body:
Hello,

Could you please check the fastest air freight option from Stuttgart Airport (STR) to Tel Aviv (TLV, IL) and send us your all-in price in EUR?

The shipment will be ready on 2026-11-27, and we will deliver it to STR ourselves. It consists of 11 pieces of maintenance spray cans, with a gross weight of 1223 kg and a volume of 2.96 cbm.

The packing list is attached. Please let us know the earliest possible departure and arrival.

Viele Gruesse / Many greetings
Deniz Yilmaz
Rheintal Elektronik GmbH

Sent: 2026-10-12

pls quote air freight ex VIENNA AIRPORT to SGN:

classification.reasoning: The customer is requesting an all-in price and fastest air freight option for a new shipment from STR to TLV.
